{{Quote|So, what brings a mammal such as yourself to the hives of Geonosis?|Vrixx'tt, to a group of fugitives on the run from the Hutt Teemo|<ref name="The Long Arm of the Hutt">{{FFG|story=The Long Arm of the Hutt|book=Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Beginner Game|text=''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Beginner Game}}</ref>}}
'''Vrixx'tt''' was a [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as one of his people's [[Findsman/Legends|findsmen]], a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunting]] tradition. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Vrixx'tt attended a private party that was held by the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Noble/Legends|noble]] [[Duke/Legends|Duke]] [[Piddock]], of the [[Gogum Hive]]. Vrixx'tt hoped to negotiate a weapons deal with Piddock on behalf of a group of Gand [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]], but he kept his true agenda hidden from the other attendees and claimed to be a representative of an informal organization that sort to promote the interests of [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. During the event, Vrixx'tt spoke privately with Piddock, and he also encountered a group of fugitives who were on the run from the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Teemo/Legends|Teemo]]. Via his wrist-mounted communicator, the Gand learned that Teemo had posted a bounty on the fugitives. When group left the party, Vrixx'tt followed them and ambushed the fugitives on the [[Hangar/Legends|landing platform]] [[Gantry AA7]], as they headed back to their [[Starship/Legends|starship]].<ref name="The Long Arm of the Hutt" />
